failureTrace.source: r1-ordinary-report.json afterTap-9 plus R2 paired dispatch traces
failureTrace.boundaryObservation: The observed y≈-127.6 is above the upper fall boundary y+17<-110; fail('fall') then zeros velocity and appends the fall event.
failureTrace.observedR2Terminal: In the regenerated capture comparison, with-screenshots reached failed/spike at input 10 while the no-screenshot run remained anchored after input 10; this is a paired diagnostic observation, not a root-cause determination.

captureComparison.conclusion: The capture and no-capture runs diverged in wall-clock trajectory timing before terminal; screenshot overhead remains a hypothesis. The comparison does not establish that screenshots caused the game failure and does not assign a source root cause.
